items.question: What product categories does Moldart supply?
items.answer: Moldart works across wood-working and metallurgical supply, including lamination tooling, engineered substrates, flooring and furniture systems, decorative stainless steel, and industrial press plates.

items.question: Do you support custom sizes and technical specifications?
items.answer: Yes. Many product families can be aligned to customer dimensions, finish requirements, application needs, and production constraints.

items.question: Can Moldart support export-oriented or international requirements?
items.answer: Yes. The business model already positions Moldart around European quality expectations, coordinated sourcing, and project-driven supply support.

items.question: How are MOQ and lead times decided?
items.answer: MOQ and lead times depend on the product family, customization level, finish, and production planning. Moldart reviews these commercially after understanding the requirement.

items.question: Can we request technical and pricing support before finalizing?
items.answer: Yes. Buyers can share use-case details, required specifications, finish direction, and expected volumes to receive the right commercial and technical guidance.
